description: This file provides utility functions for date range calculations and formatting, using the dayjs library with timezone support. It includes functions to determine the time view based on date differences, generate date ranges with custom week start days, and format date periods for display.

methods.name: getTimeView
methods.description: Determines the time view ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year') based on the difference between start and end dates.

methods.name: getDateRanges
methods.description: Generates an array of date ranges between start and end dates, segmented by the specified time view and week start day.

methods.name: formatPeriod
methods.description: Formats a date range into a human-readable string based on the time view, omitting the year if start and end are in the same year.

methods.name: formatPeriodFull
methods.description: Formats a date range into a full human-readable string, similar to formatPeriod but with full date details.
